title: HackerRank: Plus Minus Proportions
description: Given an array of integers `arr`, calculate the ratios of its elements that are positive, negative, and zero. Return a list `[pos_ratio, neg_ratio, zero_ratio]` with values rounded to 6 decimal places.
solution:
def plus_minus(arr: list[int]) -> list[float]:
    n = len(arr)
    pos = sum(1 for x in arr if x > 0)
    neg = sum(1 for x in arr if x < 0)
    zero = sum(1 for x in arr if x == 0)
    return [round(pos / n, 6), round(neg / n, 6), round(zero / n, 6)]
explanation: Count frequencies of positive, negative, and zero elements and divide by N.
